The '''palace''' on [[Orto/Legends|Orto]] was the seat of power on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was occupied by [[Belo Tusus]] until [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nem Bees]] was able to disable its [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] generator, leaving it vulnerable to an attack from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
